Absolute synthesis reagent charges, precursor purity, detailed ramp/hold schedules for most image specimens, cooling and workup are unreported.
Source groups and analytical examples may overlap physically; absent batch IDs are not invented, and records are not asserted to be independently repeated experiments.
AlCl3 mass fractions 9.3%, 10%, 13% and 93% belong to distinct source contexts; the weight-percent denominator is not explicitly defined.
No measured atomic coordinates, exact unit cell, functional-property tests or lattice refinement supplied in this main.
Source-specific molecular and morphology refinements remain presentation pending.
Footnote 8 states a general method range of 900–1100 °C for 15 min–10 h. These ranges do not supply missing individual specimen schedules.
